newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SingTel sinks to new all-time low.
newsitem.headline: SingTel sinks to new all-time low.

text.p: Shares of Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) continued their descent Tuesday morning to hit a new all-time low at Singapore $2.35 as foreign funds unloaded the stock.
At 0225 GMT, the shares were hovering at S$2.35, down three cents on 1.7 million shares traded.
Dealers said foreign funds continued to sell the shares.
"My clients don't like the long term fundamentals of the company. It is not cheap compared to the industry," said a dealer with a European house.
SingTel shares had been battered since the company lost its monopoly in the cellular phone and paging markets in Singapore on April 1, 1997.
It is due to lose its monopoly in basic telecommunications services in April 2000.
